_comment: 1999 CRT routines whose PUBLIC declaration tools/asm.py removes, and whose PROC it marks
PRIVATE, so the symbol is supplied by the modern CRT instead. The PROC and its bytes stay
exactly where they are - .text does not move by one byte - the name simply stops being
exported, and game.asm's own internal calls still reach the original.
REMOVING THE PUBLIC LINE IS NOT ENOUGH. MASM makes a PROC visible by default, so `__itoa PROC`
still exports __itoa with no PUBLIC anywhere and the link still fails with 'already defined in
game.obj'. It must be `__itoa PROC PRIVATE`, which is how Open1560's game.asm is written
throughout.
WHY ANY OF THIS IS NEEDED. A static library links per OBJECT, not per symbol. libucrt's
atox.obj carries strtoul, strtol, atoi, atol and _atoi64 together; asking for strtoul pulls the
whole object and every one of those names collides with game.obj. So a routine can only come
from the modern CRT if the 1999 copy stops claiming its entire object group.
WHAT MAY GO IN THIS LIST. Only routines that own no state AND touch no floating point, where
the modern implementation is indistinguishable from the 1999 one: string and memory
primitives, INTEGER conversion, character classification, and the integer compiler helpers.
WHY NO FLOATING POINT - the non-obvious one. The math group was in this list and had to come
out. It pulled libucrt's 87disp.obj, whose x87 NaN dispatch helpers collide with game.obj's;
but the collision only exposed the real objection. This build compiles /arch:IA32 to keep the
compiler on x87 precisely so 80-bit intermediates round the way they did in 1999, because
collapsing them to single precision silently changes physics results. Handing pow, fmod, the
_CI* helpers or __ftol to a modern UCRT that does not share those semantics would undo the
reason /arch:IA32 is there. atof is excluded for the same reason - it produces a double - and
qsort/bsearch because the order of equal elements is not specified and the game may depend on
the original.
WHAT MUST NEVER GO IN IT. Anything owning state the still-assembly half of the image also
touches. malloc/calloc/realloc/free and _msize, because two heaps means a pointer allocated by
one and freed by the other, which is silent corruption rather than a link error. All stdio and
file I/O, because the modern CRT's copy is never initialised - the entry point is the game's
1999 start. rand (static seed), strtok (static cursor), strdup (allocates), time and localtime,
the exit and atexit chain, the SEH and NLG unwind machinery, the startup routines
(_setargv/_setenvp/_cinit/_initterm), and _controlfp/_fpreset, which own the FPU control word
that /arch:IA32 depends on.
THIS LIST IS EMPTY, AND THAT IS THE FINDING. Every candidate group was tried. The integer and
string groups privatise cleanly and their libucrt objects link - but pulling ANY libucrt object
drags the UCRT runtime with it (per_thread_data.obj, invalid_parameter.obj, errno.obj), and
those reference stdcall-decorated Win32 imports this link cannot supply. See tools/link.py.
Re-populating a group here is only worth attempting alongside decorated import libraries.
